description: 7-agent oracle swarm for confidential prediction market resolution. Agents autonomously fetch outcome data from independent sources, attest YES/NO votes, reach 5-of-7 quorum, and anchor evidence to Filecoin via Synapse SDK. Agent identities are registered in ERC-8004 on Sepolia. Intermediate evidence is checkpointed to Storacha during collection.

agents.name: Cipher
agents.personality: Data-driven analyst, trusts top-tier CEX feeds

agents.name: Specter
agents.personality: Cautious risk assessor, requires high-confidence signals

agents.name: Echo
agents.personality: Volume-weighted aggregator, weights by 24h trading volume

agents.name: Vex
agents.personality: Adversarial tester, looks for manipulation and stale data

decision_loop: discover: subscribe to market expiry events
plan: select data sources per agent
verify: check quorum status from OracleAgentRegistry
submit: upload finalized evidence to Filecoin, update reputation

storage.finalized_evidence: Filecoin Onchain Cloud via Synapse SDK (permanent, PDP-verified)
storage.reputation_snapshots: Filecoin Onchain Cloud via Synapse SDK
